How it works

From your current squad to green arrows

Three simple steps, and no account to create.

  1. 1

    Paste your Team ID

    No passwords. No emails. Just your public FPL ID and you're in. We pull your live squad, bank balance, and mini-league data straight from the official FPL servers.

  2. 2

    Get instant insights

    Our engine crunches xG, form, fixtures, and price trends to surface exactly what matters — sell/hold verdicts, captaincy picks, and transfer targets.

  3. 3

    Make winning moves

    Use the Transfer Wizard to plan your GW like a pro. Step-by-step flow from injuries to captaincy. Green arrows incoming.
